name: Human Escalation Workflow
description: Manages human escalation workflows for agent security events that require human judgment, approval, or intervention. Defines escalation paths, notification channels, and response timeframes for different incident severity levels.
threat_addressed: Automated responses handle routine failures, but deviations above a severity threshold require human judgment: context that automated systems cannot fully evaluate, regulatory reporting decisions, and risk acceptance determinations.
enforcement_mechanism: Escalation rules route deviations above severity threshold to designated reviewers (agent owner, compliance team, or CISO depending on severity) with full context: the action, failed AKSIs, regulatory impact assessment, and recommended response. SLAs defined and tracked.

security_outcome.pass: Routing rules cover all escalation scenarios. Routing functional and tested. SLAs defined and tracked.
security_outcome.fail: Escalation workflow not configured or escalation acknowledgment overdue.

display_detail: Manages human escalation workflows for security events requiring human judgment or intervention.
remediation_hint_template: Human escalation required but workflow not configured. Define escalation targets and notification channels.
